name: citation_usefulness_v1
description: Does a retrieved span answer the question the search was serving? Hand-authored, biomedical, deliberately including the failure mode a topic-overlap metric cannot see: a span on the right subject that answers a different question. Labels: useful (answers the question, for or against), partial (bears on it without settling it), useless (same topic, different question, or no bearing at all).
